lead: JRD Tata was an entrepreneur, born on 29 July 1904 in Paris.
He died on 29 November 1993 in Geneva at the age of 89.
He has been recognised with Daniel Guggenheim Medal and Bharat Ratna.
Below you will find a verified overview of JRD Tata: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: JRD Tata — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: JRD Tata was born on 29 July 1904 in Paris, and holds citizenship of British Raj and India.
Public records name his father, Ratanji Dadabhoy Tata and his mother, Suzanne RD Tata. He is a sibling of Sylla Petit, Jimmy N. Tata, Rodabeh Tata and Darab Tata.
His listed education includes Cathedral and John Connon School.

sections.heading: JRD Tata — Career and Professional Work
paras: JRD Tata works primarily as an entrepreneur and aircraft pilot.
